title: Herb & Garlic Baked Cod with Romesco Sauce
description: Thyme and garlic-rubbed cod with an almond-tomato romesco sauce and wilted spinach.
steps: Bake the fish with oil, thyme, garlic and lemon zest at 220C for 10-12 minutes.
Fry the pepper and leeks, add the almonds and tomato puree, then blitz into a thick sauce.
Serve the fish on wilted spinach with the romesco sauce.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food herb & garlic baked cod

notes: Baked cod keeps the fish flaky without added oil — a genuinely light dinner under 260 kcal.
